mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increase haloperidol's risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias; both drugs have CNS effects.
action: Monitor ECG, electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), and renal function closely; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly; consider alternative antifungal if possible; avoid other QT-prolonging drugs.
